run_status: BUILT AND SELF-TESTED ONLY. Part (a) has not run against the live table; part (b) cannot run (see what_it_cannot_read).
what_it_reads: part (a): one dynamodb SCAN (ConsistentRead true, FilterExpression SK = PROFILE, ProjectionExpression firmId, userType, status) of the users table opal-users-v2, paged by LastEvaluatedKey until no page remains

part (a) classification: a row is INTERNAL when firmId is exactly opal-capital or userType is exactly Dev or service; status is read as the string it is, 'absent' when missing, 'non-string' when the attribute is not a string, and counted active only when exactly the string active

part (b): reads nothing. The request log lines were read in the worktree at base 247a5cfe7c: _authz/served.py:81-108 and _authz/errors.py:146-201 (see LOG_EVIDENCE in the script) and the _scope/ folder, which has no log call that writes a caller identity
what_it_cannot_read: part (b), the distinct internal callers of the investor-reporting status, directory and export functions over 30 days: NOT_AVAILABLE. The log lines carry event, operation, public_reason_code and correlation_id (public line) and correlation_id, operation, exception_type, exception_text, component, reason, developer_detail and extra.classifier_code (internal record). None carries the caller's firmId, userType or identity field, so a caller cannot be matched to a users row from the logs. The script prints part_b NOT_AVAILABLE with this reason and prints no number for it

a row that the scan does not return (a PROFILE row outside the scan's pages, or a row the consistent scan fails on): the scan raises and nothing is counted (exit 3, the error code on stderr); a malformed attribute on a returned row is counted under unreadable_rows, never as active or as a known caller
any row whose firmId, userType or status is a token longer than 24 characters or holds a non-letter: bucketed as other-string, its value not printed
the status of a row whose status attribute is a non-string type: bucketed as non-string, never active
the live table: not read by this build. Zero live rows were read

part_b.part_b (always NOT_AVAILABLE in this build), part_b.reason, part_b.evidence
